source: #328 (procs-route, wave 9): a raw dev server blocks the agent's shell or leaks past the session; the hook routes it to `workit run --bg`
prompt: Start this app's dev server so I can open it in my browser, then tell me which port it is on. Leave it running.

require.why: the server runs through `workit run --bg` (typed or rewritten by the hook), whose output names its id

forbid.why: a hand-backgrounded server is unregistered: nothing stops it at the end of the session

answer.why: names the port the server listens on
